resolution: User confirmation that req_1806 resolved the choppy editor camera: 'oh yeah that react rerender was it. always is lol.' The unconditional per-frame React re-render in pushCamera (added in req_1798 for HUD tracking) was throttling the editor frame loop the loader renders embedded in; guarding it to only re-render when the 2D HUD has content (armed ghost / selection / paint) restored smooth navigation. No further code for this item — it's the user's verification of the fix. Lesson saved to memory (loader_pane_camera_react_free): keep per-frame host-driven paths out of React's render cycle in the embedded loader pane.
